text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created — streaming/tool-call error spike detected for customers in eu-west-1. Create an incident thread and start triage. Runbook: <https://company.internal/runbooks/streaming-toolcall>

leah: paging — I see a surge of ToolCallParseError exceptions in runtime-prod-gpu-2 starting ~2026-03-12T10:42:11Z. Customers report truncated streaming responses and unexpected disconnects.

omar: attaching quick snippets from the logs (tail):
```
2026-03-12T10:42:09Z ERROR runtime: SSE disconnect client_id=cls-8345 reason=read: connection reset by peer
2026-03-12T10:42:11Z ERROR parser: ToolCallParseError: unexpected '}' at position 184 (payload len 1024) model=gpt-open-1 quant=fp16
2026-03-12T10:42:12Z WARN  router: retrying request for route=/v1/stream-toolcall status=502
2026-03-12T10:42:13Z ERROR runtime: SSE disconnect client_id=cls-8346 reason=timeout after 30s
```

dina: I just checked deploy-bot — there was a canary push earlier this morning at 09:57 UTC that modified the toolcall parser (PR #4123).

deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed to 5% at 2026-03-12T09:57:01Z; promoted to stable at 2026-03-12T10:35:22Z.

maggie: timeline so far (quick):
- 09:57:01 UTC: canary rollout parser changes (5% traffic)
- 10:35:22 UTC: promoted to stable (100% for eu-west-1 region)
- ~10:42 UTC: first ToolCallParseError spike with SSE disconnects
- 10:44 UTC: on-call alerted and incident created

leah: initial hypothesis list:
1) parser regression from PR #4123 introducing a stricter JSON grammar (breaking some older client payloads)
2) network/proxy in front of runtime truncating chunked toolcall payloads (mangling trailing bytes)
3) client SDK sending trailing commas/partial frames when reusing connections under load

omar: quick repro attempts against canary binaries show same parser throwing on a payload with a stray trailing `,` after last field. Example failing payload: `{"name":"get_price", "args": {"sku":"X123"},}`

leah: that payload should have been tolerated previously — parser used to ignore trailing commas. PR diff shows we switched to a strict JSON5 parser to improve correctness; that likely regressed compatibility.

raj: i'm taking the next shift handoff. My immediate plan:
- pause promotion (if any promotion jobs still running) -> confirmed none pending
- rollback stable to previous parser build (pre-PR #4123) in eu-west-1 while mitigation is in flight
- enable fallback tolerant-parser flag for streaming route if rollback is slow

maggie: ok go ahead with rollback on eu-west-1. Post rollback watch for error rate to fall under 0.5% for 5m.

leah: rollback started at 10:49:12Z — rolling back to build 20260312-0910 (pre-PR).

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered by mage:maggie at 2026-03-12T10:49:12Z. Target: runtime-prod-eu-west-1 pool.

omar: logs after rollback (tail):
```
2026-03-12T10:50:05Z INFO  deploy: roll back to 20260312-0910 complete on runtime-prod-eu-west-1
2026-03-12T10:50:07Z INFO  parser: tolerant-parser enabled (legacy mode)
2026-03-12T10:50:09Z INFO  telemetry: ToolCallParseError rate dropping from 14.2% -> 0.8%
2026-03-12T10:50:45Z INFO  runtime: SSE reconnects normalized, client disconnects falling
```

dina: customer-impact note: we had ~1200 affected sessions across 8 paying customers (mostly small bursts), highest impact window 10:42–10:50 UTC. CS alerted two customers directly; we prepared a Q&A.

leah: current status: rollback complete, error rates returning to baseline, continue monitoring for 30m, action items for RCA below.

raj: action items — capture as part of in-incident RCA coordination: 
- collect representative failing payloads and client SDK versions (omar)
- diff parser behavior between strict vs tolerant (dina + leah)
- identify why canary promotion to stable happened despite early errors at 5% (deploy pipeline telemetry) (maggie + deploy infra)
- write mitigation docs for future tolerant-parser flag toggles (platform)

omar: pushing a Gist with sample failing payloads and counts: <https://gist.company/sample-failing-toolcall-payloads>

leah: recording hypotheses as we triage: 
- H1 (high): parser change in PR #4123 made grammar strict -> broke older client payloads containing trailing commas/partial frames. Evidence: repro on canary, diff shows switch to strict JSON library.
- H2 (medium): a proxy truncation issue amplified the failures by dropping final bytes of chunked frames under load. Evidence: some disconnects with reason=read: connection reset, need packet captures.
- H3 (low): client SDK regression sending malformed frames under new pooling behavior. Evidence needed: client SDK versions and telemetry.

maggie: for the RCA doc we should include: timeline, deploy metadata (canary %, times), failing payload samples, logs + grep commands used, mitigation decisions and rollback steps, customer impact table.

raj: leaving the incident in monitoring mode. If error rate rises above 2% again we spike and re-open. CC: @dina please coordinate CS comms for the 2 customers that asked for postmortem.

dina: will draft customer notes once we have final timeline and RCA.

leah: next steps for post-incident:
- collect full logs for 10:30–11:00 UTC (omar)
- gather canary telemetry at 5% window (deploy-bot + maggie)
- reproduce parsing failure with unit test and add coverage to prevent regression (eng-ml and runtime teams)

oncall-bot: Incident moved to MONITORING by raj at 2026-03-12T11:05:20Z. If new alerts occur, will re-escalate.

leah: thanks everyone. I'll open the RCA doc and drop a link here when ready.

maggie: nice quick rollback, good job team. :thumbsup:
